description: Estadistica Biogas y Plan de manejo Integral de Residuos solidos (PMIRS). UAESP. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Reporte mensual a la Oficina de Planeación sobre el flujo de biogas promedio tratado y aprovechad, la reducción de emisiones de GEI y la generación de energia de la planta de Biogas ubicada en el parque de Innovación Doña Juana. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Its tags are Biogas, Doña Juana, emisiones GEI. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
